title: EzWorld
description: A cool smp server where you can pvp against other players.
body: EZ World is a laid-back survival server with a competitive side, built for players who want freedom without the grind feeling impossible. Explore a custom world, build huge bases, team up with friends, trade in the player economy, or fight other players since PvP is always enabled. The server focuses on a balanced survival experience with active staff, community events, custom features, and a friendly player base that keeps the server active every day. Whether you enjoy building, raiding, grinding for gear, or just hanging out with the community, EZ World gives you a place to play your own way.
